capture_hooks.AlienPetAdReel: Compiled in development/COGHE_MOBILE_BENCHMARK; desktop command-line only; forces 540 × 960 and 2× capture; cannot directly trigger unchanged on Android.
capture_hooks.AlienPetCareReel: Same activation/size limitation as AdReel; in-memory ownership/unlock fixture, real food/style interactions.
capture_hooks.COgheViewProofPlayer: Android intent extras exist in test APK, but PersistenceEnabled=false disables ProductMode unless overridden; developer HUD makes this hook unsuitable for store images. Not used for recommended captures.
capture_hooks.COgheMobileUIProof: Android boolean coghe_ui_proof; native-resolution menu/game/victory/Home/Style shots; fixture temporarily substitutes test ads, in-memory unlocks; excluded from store APK.
capture_hooks.final_store_apk: Installed and smoked with ordinary native taps/swipe/pinch. No test hooks were used in store APK.

store_screenshot_guidance.large_screen_guidance: Four or more actual in-game images per tablet category; 1080–7680 px; 9:16 portrait or 16:9 landscape; avoid added promotional text. General upload limits are separately 320–3840 px, max/min <= 2, JPEG or opaque 24-bit PNG.

setup_notes: The first create attempt occurred while extraction was finishing and returned package-not-yet-valid; retry after SDK install exit 0 succeeded.
Read-only avdmanager required Android Studio bundled Java runtime; JAVA_HOME used for individual commands only.

Pixel Tablet natural display is landscape. The 7-inch-class override used wm size 1920x1200, yielding portrait app/screenshot 1200x1920 after ROTATION_90. The first 1200x1920 override was landscape at runtime and triggered an Android education overlay; those setup images are excluded from recommended ASO sources. Native size was restored after capture.

store_smoke.input_method: Ordinary Android shell taps/swipe, plus external two-pointer MotionEvent injection for pinch; no gameplay test hooks or save editing.
